Personality: Belwas is boisterous and gluttonous, using the scars across his body as proof that he has never gone down easily in the fighting pits. He knows nothing of courtly etiquette, yet he knows well who is willing to feed him and who dares to stand shoulder to shoulder with him.
Background: Belwas is a brawny warrior from the fighting pits of Slaver's Bay, castrated in youth and trained as a pit fighter. Accompanying Barristan to Daenerys's side, he is known for his close-quarters prowess, blunt speech, and prodigious appetite.
